summary: Explains how Mobile IPv4 can work together with IPsec-based VPN gateways for enterprise users who roam while connected remotely. It gives an applicability statement for combining the two and defines a secure way for a device to detect whether it is on the trusted internal network. It is on the standards track.

eli5.summary: Picture an employee who walks between buildings while holding a secure tunnel back to the office. This explains how to keep that private tunnel working as the person moves, and how the device can tell when it is already inside.

questions: how to use mobile ip behind a vpn gateway
detect trusted internal network mobile ip
